newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ISMA to work more closely with regions.
newsitem.headline: ISMA to work more closely with regions.

text.p: The International Securities Market Association (ISMA) plans to work more closely with its regional members, ISMA said at its annual general meeting on Thursday.
After surveying its 820 members in 51 countries, ISMA said it recognised the need to strengthen and increase communication with its 13 regional committees.

Around two-thirds of members replied to the survey, and although the majority said they did not want to take a more active role within their ISMA region, they would be interested in attending more information meetings and education courses.
Forty-four percent of respondents said they did not want any more social events.
Sixty-one percent said they would welcome an ISMA regional newsletter, although 56 percent did not want to contribute to such a publication.
"ISMA is using regional committees more since last year's AGM, and this has been a very positive development," the head of one regional committee told Reuters.
This is ISMA's second attempt to canvass its members' views, and this year's effort appears to have been better received than the 1996 attempt.

At the 1996 AGM in Cannes, ISMA's board revealed the conclusions of another survey, but the study was criticised as being unrepresentative due to the poor response rate and the full results were not distributed to members.
This time around, ISMA will be sending a copy of the full results to all its members, together with a copy of the questionnaire.
